_comment: The incident severity table of the Defender XDR implementation guide's Gate 6 (risk-based recommended; the response windows are program design). Graph incident severities are informational, low, medium and high (Learn, 'List incidents'); informational shares the low row. An incident is triaged when it has an owner (assignedTo); the Graph incident carries no time of first assignment, so the kit reports whether an incident is still unowned past its window, not how long triage took.

rows.rung: L3 gated: the playbook prepares, a named approver releases
rows.handoff: IR lead and ISSO; reporting decision under the incident response plan
